```yaml
name: Assign milestone to PRs

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, reopened]

jobs:
  assign-milestone:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up .NET SDK
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v1
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0'

      - name: Get PR author
        id: pr_author
        run: echo "::set-output name=author::$(git log -1 --pretty=%an)"

      - name: Assign milestone
        if: github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' || github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'BornToBeRoot'
        run: |
          gh pr edit ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --add-milestone next-release
```

          node-version: '14'

      - name: Get PR author
        id: pr_author
        run: echo "::set-output name=author::$(git log -1 --pretty=%an)"

      - name: Assign labels
        if: github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'dependabot[bot]' || github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'transifex-integration[bot]' || github.event.pull_request.user.login == 'imgbot[bot]'
        run: |
          gh pr edit ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }} --add-label ':heavy_check_mark: dependencies'
